description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, the NESAC ft model and the SESHA ft model, across five different optimizations applied to the Whisper system for regional dialects in the UK. The optimizations include Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The x-axis represents the model performance, measured in a numerical scale, while the y-axis lists the optimizations. The NESAC ft model is represented by orange bars and the SESHA ft model by green bars. The NESAC ft model shows a consistent performance across all optimizations, with the highest value at 0.00334 for Normalised and the lowest at 0.00257 for Dates. The SESHA ft model also shows consistent performance, with the highest value at 0.00344 for Add Spacing and the lowest at 0.00228 for Dates. The values are indicated on the bars, and the scale ranges from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick labels at intervals of 0.0001. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
